_comment: #5909 regression: an OCR'd Lantmateriet Fastighetsrapport. The value strategies read positionally (the cell BELOW a column header); OCR linearises the page so the positional read finds nothing, and objekt was lost even though the beteckning survived the scan. This fixture is a SYNTHETIC fastighetsrapport (no client document or PII): the beteckning 'TESTKOMMUN PROVTRAKT 9:99' is invented, and the header row is the documented 3-cell 'Beteckning / Senaste andring allmanna delen / Totalareal'. The OCR objekt fallback anchors on the last header (Totalareal) and takes the single designation after it, so the header words stay out of the value.
